items.title: Burnham says he wants to cut welfare bill 'as soon as we possibly can'
items.summary: Opponents have questioned the Budget's lack of detail on welfare reform, with the prime minister not outlining a timetable for any reductions.

items.title: 'Painful' years ahead, think tanks warn, as living standards set to fall
items.summary: Budget forecasts show growth in living standards grinding almost to a halt.

items.title: Audio reveals exchanges between control centre and drivers before deadly Spain train crash
items.summary: The recordings appear to show one high-speed train was given clearance to move even though another up ahead had stalled.

items.title: Russell Brand's wife tells his rape trial he is 'kind and a wonderful father'
items.summary: Laura Brand tells the jury at his trial she feels "very seen by him" and "I love him very much".

items.title: Met refers itself to police watchdog over letter about Meghan's father
items.summary: The police force faces scrutiny over its handling of a letter containing allegations about Meghan's father.

items.title: Jury shown CCTV of Huntingdon train staff using frying pan in defence
items.summary: Witnesses say Samir Zitouni is a 'real-life hero' who told attacker "We love you, we can help you".

items.title: Flávio Bolsonaro calls himself 'leader of Brazil' after election loss
items.summary: The defeated presidential candidate says he will lead the opposition from the US.

items.title: George Michael's Faith guitar sells for £180k after auction row
items.summary: The brother of the singer's late personal assistant said she would not have wanted the items to be sold.
